pages.title: Chamois
pages.text: The chamois ($(o)Rupicapra rupicapra$()) is a small goat-antelope of the mountains of Europe and the Caucasus.$(br2)It has short, black horns that curve back into a hook, and a pale face crossed by dark stripes running through the eyes.$(br2)Chamois are swift and agile on steep, broken ground, and can leap remarkable distances.
